failures.triage_note: Battle #4 (Oliver Brooks vs Mina Aoki) and Tournament #5 entries (Spring Photography Championship) reference wp_users IDs 2, 3, 5, 6 which no longer exist on this dev site (current real users are 1, 7-13). Root cause is leftover fixture data from a much older QA baseline (2026-04-23), not a 2.3.1 code defect. The frontend correctly avoids a fatal and falls back to an 'Unknown' placeholder identity + generic avatar rather than crashing, which is graceful degradation, but the visual result ('Unknown vs Unknown') looks broken on /compete/ Recent Results and on the tournament bracket. A freshly-created battle (#7, varundubey vs Oliver Brooks, both real users) rendered names correctly, confirming name resolution itself is not broken. Recommend a fixture cleanup pass (delete or reassign mvs_competitions/mvs_competition_entries rows whose user_id has no matching wp_users row) before the next run. Does not block the 2.3.1 tag.
failures.expected: Recent Results / bracket shows real display names for battle and tournament participants.
failures.actual: Shows 'Unknown' with a generic placeholder avatar for participants whose wp_users row was deleted in a prior QA cycle.

failures.triage_note: Two dirty pre-existing rows surface on /media/ across all 4 Pro layout modes: (1) media_id=124, title='tiny', a genuine 1x1px private test image left over from a prior thumbnail-backfill test (title/slug/original_filename all say 'tiny'; 3 sibling rows tiny/tiny-1/tiny-2 also exist in the admin's own My Media tab) - the plugin correctly serves the file as-is (it IS 1x1), so the black tile is accurate rendering of bad fixture data, not a serving bug. (2) media_id=22 has NULL file_url/media_type/title and a permalink of /media/qa-own-album-1785596565438/, i.e. an orphaned 'qa-own-album' fixture (likely an album row) that the Explore feed query pulls in as if it were a plain media item; the template correctly falls back to a generic-file placeholder icon rather than a broken , which is the intended no-dead-image contract. Both are QA-environment data hygiene issues from earlier smoke/unit-test runs, not caused by 2.3.1 changes. Recommend a fixture sweep (delete media_id 22 and the 4 'tiny' rows) so future Explore/layout screenshots aren't dominated by black/placeholder tiles.
failures.expected: Explore/layout feeds show only real photo content; no empty-record rows leak into the grid.
failures.actual: A black 1x1 tile and a generic-file-icon placeholder tile appear at the top of every layout (instagram/flickr/pinterest/dribbble) because of two leftover test-fixture rows.
